text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to staging (wave 2) detected elevated 5xx rate. health.frontend: 1.7% -> 6.2% over the last 3m. Healthcheck failures on frontend-lb-1. Abort criteria met, initiating automatic rollback. Rolling back to revision v2026.02. Rolling back... DONE. Incident INC-2026-045 created.

Alice (oncall): paging eng-oncall :rotating_light: I saw the incident — I'm taking first-response.

Ben (eng-sre): On it. Looking at proxy and backend logs now. Can you confirm rollback completed for all staging pods?

Alice (oncall): rollback shows success in the deploy logs, traffic shifted back to previous revision. But 5xx still elevated briefly, could be in-flight. Tailing logs.

Carol (support): Support triage thread: two users reported timeouts in the last 10 minutes (ids collected). No major uptick in tickets yet but customers are worried.

Dave (cs): I have the request IDs from customer A: req-6f3a2 and req-6f3a7. Sharing with Ben now.

Ben (eng-sre): thanks. Quick grep example: `kubectl -n staging logs deploy/frontend --since=15m | grep req-6f3a2` — initial look shows 502s coming from quantize-worker pool hitting header-parsing errors.

Alice (oncall): noted. Handoff to Ben for deeper triage. I'll stay on channel until we've got a mitigation or clear.

incident-bot: Handoff assigned: Alice -> Ben. Pager status: acknowledged.

Ben (eng-sre): digging into the canary config diff now. Found an env/header change in the new image: added `X-Client-Meta` header that increases request header size; some upstream nginx/proxy timeouts triggered leading to backend 502/504. Reverting header injection in canary would stop it, rollback already did, but we need a permanent fix before next rollout.

Erin (pm): If rollout fix + validation will take >30m, we should prepare a customer note. Carol, please standby for template, we'll only send if impact crosses thresholds (>=5% errors or >5 paying customers).

Carol (support): Got it. Drafting a short interim status message in the CS thread. Will escalate to SRE if we see another report.

Ben (eng-sre): I pushed a small patch to remove the header manipulation in the staging branch and restarted the staging pods. Monitoring: 5xx dropping to baseline. `curl` healthcheck now returns 200 consistently.

Alice (oncall): confirm numbers please — what's 5xx now?

Ben (eng-sre): 5xx back to 0.2% over last 5m. Latency normal. No further customer reports in the last 10m.

Erin (pm): Good. Let's keep an eye for 15 more minutes then consider enabling a guarded rollout with the header change disabled.

Alice (oncall): I'll mark the incident as mitigated for now. Next steps: Ben to include fix in PR and run canary without header. Postmortem: label release, rollback, header-regression, customer-impact.

Carol (support): Sending interim note to the two customers who reported issues. Will escalate if they reply. :white_check_mark:

Ben (eng-sre): Opening a follow-up ticket (SRE-2026-278) to add header-size validation to the staging checks and to add a canary gating rule for header changes.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned owners: Ben (triage), Carol (customer comms), Alice (oncall follow-up).

Alice (oncall): thanks team. If nothing else crops up I'll close this thread after the monitoring window. :thumbsup:
